chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from some of our companions, from Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, became angry with the Shiʿah, so He gave me the choice of myself or them; so I protected them, by Allah, with myself.

key_terms.الشِّيعَةِ: the Shiʿah; the followers and adherents of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.بِنَفْسِي: with myself; meaning by offering or exposing himself in their place
key_terms.غَضِبَ: became angry; refers to divine anger in response to the condition of the people
key_terms.فَخَيَّرَنِي: so He gave me the choice; indicates being presented with an option
key_terms.فَوَقَيْتُهُمْ: so I protected them; means shielding or preserving them from harm

ai.seo_question: How does Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام describe protecting the Shiʿah with himself?
ai.summary: This hadith presents Imam Mūsā عليه السلام describing his self-sacrifice for the Shiʿah when divine anger had befallen them. It highlights the Imam’s protective role, his devotion to his followers, and a profound dimension of his leadership and wilāyah.
